name: school_interior_entrance
description: A welcoming foyer of the Greek village school where children enter, with open arched doors revealing the sunlit exterior courtyard.

color_palette: Soft blue (#ADD8E6) for interior walls to keep continuity with the classrooms and create a calm arrival.
Warm yellow (#FFD700) for trim, signage, and accents to feel cheerful and inviting.
Aegean blue (#0F4C81) for the double door frames and hooks to emphasize the Mediterranean character and draw the eye to the open doorway.
Rich green (#228B22) in a small potted plant and rug motifs to suggest growth and welcome.
visual_style.architectural_style: Whitewashed stucco with exposed wooden beams and a low, cozy ceiling typical of traditional Greek village schools. An arched, wide double doorway remains open to frame a clear view of the sunlit exterior facade and courtyard.
visual_style.furniture: Honey-oak benches with cubbies (accented in warm yellow) line the side walls at child height, with Aegean-blue pegs above for cloaks and bags. A narrow console table in soft blue near the door holds a clay bowl for notes, and a patterned runner guides children to the open doorway.
materials: Whitewashed stucco walls with exposed wooden beams
Stone floor with a Greek-key mosaic threshold and woven wool runner
Double wooden doors painted Aegean blue with simple wrought-iron pulls
Blue-and-white ceramic tiles for a small entry splash zone
